page.layout: One page of manuscript only: an ownership inscription at the top, and below it a decorative band of ink flourishes. No printed text.
page.notes: The page carries no printed text. The top lines are handwritten ownership: "Iosephus Werner" with "Basiliensis Anno Domini" and "1622" in brown ink. The band of scrolled ink ornament below is also handwriting, not print. Both are left out as handwriting, per the rules. The scan shows a blank page beneath them.
